Frequently Asked Questions

Can I cancel anytime?

Yes, cancel through your Whop dashboard. You retain access until the end of your billing cycle.

What happens to my progress?

Progress, quiz scores, and streak data are tied to your account and remain even if a membership lapses.

How do AI animations work?

Premium tiers grant access to our AI generation engine for creating custom visualizations of philosophical concepts.

Is there a community?

Practitioner and Teacher tiers include private Discord access with direct Q&A and monthly live sessions.
